simple.meaning: אָדַב (ʼâdab) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to languish.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in 1 Samuel, beginning at 1 Samuel 2:33. The surrounding contexts include altar.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָדַב (H109) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אָדַב (ʼâdab) / H109 is traced through 1 Samuel 2:33 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The man of yours whom I don’t cut off from my altar will consume your eyes§ or, blind your eyes with tears and grieve your heart. All the increase of your house will die in the flower of their age.
